items.title: Humana’s (NYSE:HUM) Q3 2026 sales top estimates but full-year sales guidance misses expectations
items.summary: Health insurance company Humana (NYSE:HUM) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q3 2026, with revenue up 26.1% year on year to $41.16 billion. On the other hand, the company’s full-year revenue guidance of $160 billion at the midpoint came in 1.7% below analysts’ consensus estimates. Its non-GAAP loss of $0.70 per share was 30.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
